# Tagcast 1.3.0 — Follow the music

Tagcast 1.3.0 brings online lyrics to the expanded Now playing view, more reliable
lyrics searches in the editor, the Apple Music Classic palette and a focused round
of reliability and security fixes. All features from 1.2.0 remain included.

## Lyrics that follow the track

Open expanded **Now playing → Lyrics** to read alongside the music. Under
**Settings → Playback → Now playing lyrics**, choose saved iBroadcast lyrics,
iBroadcast first with **Unison → LRCLIB** fallback, or online lyrics first with
iBroadcast fallback. **iBroadcast only remains the default.**

When the source provides timing, Tagcast follows the active line and highlights
timed words or syllables. Ordinary text remains readable when timing is unavailable.
An optional background picks up colours from the album cover. Pause, seeking, playback
speed and compatible Gapless Playback use the same player's track-relative clock.
No second playback engine is introduced.

Online matching handles common release labels and artist-credit variations while
keeping live, acoustic and remix distinctions meaningful. Temporary provider errors
and rate limits no longer look like a permanent missing result. Availability and
timing quality depend on the contributed source; a metadata match is not a guarantee.

Online lookup is optional and runs while the expanded lyrics view is open. It sends
title, artist, album and known duration, never audio or iBroadcast credentials.
Results are attributed and held temporarily in memory; they are not automatically
saved to iBroadcast or copied into the editor. The LRCLIB source switch also controls
the fallback. See [Now playing lyrics](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/wiki/Lyrics#now-playing-lyrics).

## Better Find lyrics, with the same save safeguards

The editor's explicit **Find lyrics on LRCLIB** now uses the improved matching and
provider recovery too. Valid ordinary text takes priority; supported timed results
are converted to plain text before use. Older cached misses do not block the new
search. Unison remains a temporary display source.

The workflow is still **Find → Use these lyrics → Review → Save**. Searching does
not change your draft or library. Premium saving retains fresh conflict checks,
unknown custom userdata, a single reviewed write and read-back confirmation.
Album LRC/TXT import remains available separately.

## Appearance and listening

- **Apple Music Classic** joins Forest, Ocean, Warm and iBroadcast inspired, with
  Light and Dark variants and red-pink accents.
- Custom themes can optionally set **Sidebar icons** independently. Older theme
  JSON remains compatible and keeps its inherited icon colours.
- An optional **live spectrum** offers compact-player placements and an animated
  playing-row indicator where supported. It observes the existing audio element;
  it does not change playback or output selection. Reduced-motion preferences are
  respected, and the spectrum can be switched off.
- Wrapped album links in playlist tracklists stay left aligned.
- The downloadable theme collection remains available on [tagcast.app](https://tagcast.app/themes.html).

## Reliability and security

- Temporary sign-in refresh failures preserve saved credentials instead of signing
  you out. A confirmed invalid login remains distinct from a network problem.
- Queue restoration and delayed seeking stay attached to the intended track.
  Local queues survive until an explicit Queue Sync choice; exhausted queues can
  start correctly when adding music or choosing Play next.
- Cleanup and editor/read-back replies recover safely when the loaded library is
  replaced. Completed background results release retained library summaries.
- Small artwork failures are handled without inline scripts blocked by the desktop
  security policy; unreadable upload folders now produce a useful preparation error.
- Interrupted downloads reject unsafe resume responses and distinguish cancellation
  from actual failure. Existing files remain protected.
- The bundled certificate trust store is updated and checked in extracted desktop
  packages. External streaming-quality text is escaped, and diagnostic log rotation
  retains private file permissions.
- Release publication waits for all four verified distributions and their checksums,
  including matching macOS signing evidence. Manual rebuilds cannot silently replace
  published signed downloads.

## Upgrading and platform notes

Quit the older Tagcast before upgrading. Existing settings, credentials, themes,
favourites and other preferences are retained. Standalone downloads include Python
for macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Windows x64 and Linux x64. Source/browser use
remains supported with Python 3.11+ or uv.

Experimental Gapless Playback remains optional and off by default, with its existing
compatible ordered-album scope and ordinary-playback fallback. This update adds no
crossfade or universal sample-accuracy claim. Linux needs a compatible graphical
desktop and Chromium sandbox support; distribution-specific restrictions, including
Ubuntu 24.04 configurations, can require system setup. Do not disable the sandbox.

## Code signing and privacy

The **macOS downloads are Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple**, verified
after archive extraction. Windows signing through SignPath is not yet active;
Windows downloads are not Authenticode signed. See the [Code signing policy](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast#code-signing-policy)
and [Privacy policy](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v1.3.0/PRIVACY.md).
Original music files are never retagged or changed by Tagcast.
